cloudActivationTruth.contradiction: One lane audited and recorded that a full project (prj_RWUPf14w1xIz9NK92AbNW5z7qDCg) and a private lite project (prj_ZMfDCuUva2kdMv6HnqGvIE5vihTz) exist, with a READY production deployment. The 404 on an exact id is the strongest probe available from here and it is a direct negative, but it proves unreachability through this connection rather than non-existence in the account. defectsFound.summary: A worker result could declare an employee role the task never granted.
defectsFound.mechanism: employeeRoleIdentityErrors returned [] whenever the task carried no binding, so every mismatch check was blind to an expectation of nothing. bindEmployeeRoleSubmissionPayload then carried the claimed role into the durable submission payload.
defectsFound.evidenceBefore: attack output: 3 findings; a generic task admitted a result declaring employee:executive/cfo
defectsFound.evidenceAfter: attack output: no finding -- the identity seam holds
defectsFound.fix: Refused, not stripped, at all three binders and through a nested result inside a receipt.

defectsFound.summary: The mesh -> relay -> employee task id chain could not be walked backwards.
defectsFound.mechanism: Three ids (mesh_task_*, agent_task_*, employee_task_*), each derived from and overwriting the previous, so a run snapshot named a task recoverable only by guessing and recomputing a digest.
defectsFound.fix: compileEmployeeAgentTask keeps relayTaskId; relayRef records taskId, relayTaskId and intentTaskId.

defectsFound.summary: The reachability ratchet could not see nested API routes.
defectsFound.mechanism: Single-level readdirSync missed api/webhooks/billing.mjs and api/admin/health-check.mjs, so eight modules were reported unreachable. Four are wired to a live route. The obvious green fix -- classifying all eight as AWAITING_ACTIVATION -- would have recorded in the canonical place that live production code awaits an activation that does not exist.
defectsFound.fix: Entry-point discovery recurses. src keeps its single-level scan; its own subtrees (src/overnight, src/omnia-v9) are an uncovered scope question recorded in the test, not widened here.

defectsFound.summary: The canon guard accepted a well-formed SHA that was not in this branch's history.
defectsFound.mechanism: Reproduced with a real dangling commit: the format check passes it and the staleness check passes it, because git reports nothing changed since a commit still in the object store.
defectsFound.fix: merge-base --is-ancestor against HEAD. Reachability, not existence: cat-file -e succeeds on an orphan until it is collected, which is the window in which this goes wrong.
defectsFound.mutationEntry: none -- the guard lives in the test, not a source file, so the mutation harness has nothing to sabotage. The orphan experiment is the equivalent proof.
